newsitem.title: USA: Jan chip sales fall 3.1 pct from Dec--trade group.
newsitem.headline: Jan chip sales fall 3.1 pct from Dec--trade group.

text.p: Worldwide sales of semiconductor chips in January totalled $10.64 billion, down 3.1 percent from December sales of $10.99 billion, the Semiconductor Industry Association reported Thursday.
January sales were down 14.1 percent from the year-earlier total of $12.78 billion, the trade association said in a statement.
In North and South America combined, January sales were $3.43 billion, down from $3.53 billion in December.
In the Asia-Pacific region, sales fell to $2.25 billion from $2.34 billion in December.
In Japan, sales fell to $2.69 billion from $2.79 billion in December.
In Europe, sales fell 2.8 percent from December to $2.27 billion.
